byte_check.stop_rule: Any mismatch or error: byte-check.json, stopped.json, TERM cleanup, no retry

m0q_training.receipt_substitution: v053 wrapper meta.json + train_log.jsonl replace the v0351 training receipts

memory_correction.comparability: Frozen numerical thresholds retained descriptively; this infrastructure correction is not evidence of historical exchangeability
memory_correction.exceptions: Direct manager.start git/materialization and other direct subprocess host helpers remain under the outer 48GiB service cap only
memory_correction.global_oom_policy: No kernel CONSTRAINT_NONE events after admission journal cursor through final cleanup
memory_correction.scope: Commands routed through SubprocessManager.exec: agent, verification pytest, and setup commands using that path

policy: Launch byte check, then three routing/tool canaries (one per M0q alias), then three fixed48 runs; no efficacy stopping, analysis, submission or training

readings.MCq_i: loop <= 0.30 AND submit >= 0.80 AND M5 repeat-after-error <= 0.20 (M0qmc)
readings.MCq_ii: |delta loop| <= 0.10 AND |delta submit| <= 0.10 AND |delta M5-error| <= 0.10 (delta = M0qmc - M0q)
readings.otherwise: intermediate: paired 95% task-bootstrap intervals, no label
readings.resolution: not predicted; pooled M0qmc >= 4/120 reported as notable and bounded, never as recovery

deviations_from_v051_runner: Runs: three explicit M0q runs v055_M0qmc_s{1,2,3} served as v053_M0q_s{n} from sft/runs/A1_M0q_v053 with the v054 run definitions (run_m0q_eval_v054.py generation_runs) and v055 names; v051 renamed the readout M0 runs (v051 generation_runs). prepare checks that the v054 runs equal them except name and paths.

Training coupling: the v051 M0 qualification through the v0351 receipts (qualified_training, TRAIN_RUNTIME_SHA, the training approval in verify_runtime and prepare) is replaced by the v054 M0q qualification (qualified_m0q: wrapper meta.json + train_log.jsonl checked against M0) plus the pre-registered adapter 4c8f1f49 and meta 35259bc8 hashes; the composition-check receipt 0a9e835f is pinned and bound in verify_runtime.

Comparator: v054 M0q (runner db26da29, runtime 75c82f37, evidence migration/m0q-eval-v054/evaluation, report fbbffc9f, per_task 79427bb2) replaces the sealed v043 M0. Staged submissions must equal the v054 M0q submission inventory of the same seed and the manifest the v054 server-manifest inventory; expected_vllm_argv starts from the recorded v054 vLLM argv; server_environment is the v054 runtime value.

Server script: tools/serve_vllm_matched_v055.py is byte-identical to tools/serve_vllm_matched_v051.py (serve.diff against it is empty) and is still checked to be serve_vllm.py plus the one template flag.

Byte check: same trace, calls, template, offline render, endpoint and stop rule as v051; the /tokenize request names the v055 alias v053_M0q_s1 instead of the trace model alias, which the v055 server does not register (the adapter directories hold no tokenizer, so every alias tokenizes with the base tokenizer).

Names: unit prefix gemma-v055-eval-, service receipt prefix v055, receipts migration/matched-context-v055/evaluation, manifest subs/v055_M0qmc_manifest, server log logs/v055_server.log, run logs logs/v055_M0qmc_s{n}.log (no doubled generation prefix), canary logs and results v055_canary_v055_M0qmc_s{n}; completion status all_three_m0qmc_evaluations_qualified.

Receipts as in v054: activation.json records m0q_training and the user-manager failed units (record only, team-lead ruling 2026-11-05); stopped.json records the idle-check offenders at stop; completed.json binds m0q_training instead of training_completed_sha256; activation and qualification require the live M0q receipt to equal the one in the runtime contract.

CPU-only --preflight (from v054, plus disk, template, adapter, meta, composition, prereg, server-script and runtime-contract checks) writes migration/matched-context-v055/preflight-<UTC>.json with exclusive create; it takes no lock, launches nothing and reads no outcome.

prepare writes runner.diff against the v051 runner and runner-vs-v054.diff against the v054 runner, and pins the v051 parents, the v054 comparator sources, receipts and analysis outputs, the M0q adapter files, the wrapper, the M0 reference adapter and meta, the data manifest and update groups, the dequant manifest and the frozen trainer sources.
